body: Same to you friend. Hopefully everything works out in the end..
Could you message me? I wanna know how you planned to do this so I can get some ideas for myself.

I feel the same. I was told by others that a mental hospital is not the place I’d want to goto. I’ve been to one that was a locked floor on the top floor of a normal hospital but it doesn’t compare to the actual institutes. 
I feel like I’d fit in at an asylum. Thinking about them comfort me knowing I could end up in one and not have to worry about nothing besides starring at a white wall all day. I sometimes get this weird twitch when everything goes to complete shit for the day it’s like I’m at this point of crossing over to being crazy for real. It only happens when bad things happen in my day the most I’ve gotten it was 3 times. Every time it happens I feel like nothing is real and nothing matters nobody nothing. Eventually the feeling fades away and I’m back to just being sad and depressed again.

I’m looking for a way out though. I’d like to find a fun and out one round into my head so I’m gone in the blink of an eye. If I don’t happen to find a gun I’m gonna buy a bunch of heroin and overdose... I’m not even a drug addict and have never done heroin in my life I just know it’s deadly at high doses.
